label: captain
definition: Whoever drives an approved plan: the captain session (a Session in the captain role), cckit watch --merge, or /kit-autopilot. It gates the open PRs, squash-merges the CLEAN ones, closes their issues, advances the wave, and files and links work that emerges mid-wave. It removes every impediment itself; only the four genuine blockers of issue-lifecycle.md section 2 reach the owner.
is_not: A builder: a builder implements one issue in its worktree and never merges.
A reviewer: the captain reads the gate and the review verdicts, it does not review the code.
The owner: the owner approves the plan; the captain executes it.
